name: Platinum Vape Disposable | Black Cherry Rush
description:
Dark, juicy, and dangerously smooth.

Black Cherry Rush hits with bold cherry flavor and a sweet-tart finish that keeps you coming back for more. Every pull delivers pure Platinum distillate — clean, potent, and made to elevate your mood without slowing your roll.

With advanced dual-coil tech and precision airflow, this 2-gram all-in-one brings bigger clouds and richer flavor in every hit. Sleek, rechargeable, and ready to ride wherever the night takes you.

Flavor Profile: Black Cherry • Sweet • Tart

Effect: Euphoric • Relaxed • Uplifted

Device: Rechargeable 2G Distillate Disposable • All-In-One • Smooth Draw Design
